mechanism: Isocarboxazid (MAOI) combined with valbenazine (VMAT2 inhibitor) increases risk of hypertensive crisis and serotonergic toxicity due to monoamine accumulation and potential for excessive noradrenergic/dopaminergic activity.
action: Avoid concurrent use; if valbenazine is necessary, discontinue MAOI at least 14 days prior and monitor closely for hypertensive crisis and CNS effects.
